snippet.title: Factions of Fate | Trailer | Hidden-identity board game for 5 to 12 players
snippet.description:
Everyone at this table has a secret. Some of them want you dead.

Factions of Fate is a hidden-identity board game for 5 to 12 players, played online on a 3D table in your browser. You're dealt a secret character card from one of three factions. Renegades win when every Sentinel is dead, Sentinels win when every Renegade is dead, and each Unbound character chases a goal of their own. Nobody knows whose side you're on until you reveal yourself, which unleashes your character's power but tells the whole table where you stand.

Each turn the Fates send you to one of ten places, each with a power of its own: draw, steal, heal, curse or pray to the dead. Attack anyone in range, and answer every attack, card and ability in the response window. Intuition cards are read in secret and handed to another player, whose answer can give them away. The table enforces every rule, and bots fill any empty seats.

65 characters. One secret each. Trust no one.

Play free in your browser: https://factionsoffate.com

Made by VagueDustin Enterprises. The music and sound effects are from the game.
